info.name: VPIMS API
info.description:
Vehicle Parts Inventory Management System - API Collection

## Auth
- Register/Login are public (no token needed)
- For authenticated endpoints, set `authToken` variable after login

## Variables
- `baseUrl`: `https://localhost:7001` (adjust as needed)
- `authToken`: paste JWT token here after login
- `customerId`, `saleId`, `partId`, etc.: set from responses

request.description: Login - returns JWT token. Copy token into `authToken` variable.
Register a new customer (public) - same as auth/register
Add a vehicle to own account (Customer role)
Create a new staff user (Admin only)
Update staff user details (Admin only). All fields optional.
Create a new sale (Customer/Admin/Staff). Only items is required.
